RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of a four (4)-year Contract with 72 Hour LLC dba National Auto Fleet Group With a one (1)-year extension option, by joining Sourcewell Contract 081325-NAF, covering purchase of cars, trucks, vans, sport utility vehicles, cab chassis, and other vehicles for Los Angeles International Airport and Van Nuys Airport, for cost not to exceed $30,000,000 (Daniel Hughes)
